review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that students having the best academic results should be rewarded; however, others believe that rewarding students showing improvements plays a crucial role. In my opinion, both groups of students should be recognized and rewarded.

Admittedly, rewarding students standing out is needlessly exact. Initially, since students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, propelling towards overall academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition has be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. This means that students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, I believe that students having improved should be also rewarded. Firstly, only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, causing others to think that their effort is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. This prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, gradually losing the incentive to study. Added to this is that emphasizing improvements can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. It naturally follows that the constant desire to outdo themselves, even benefiting themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.

In conclusion, I firmly convinced that both students including outstanding students, improving students or improved ones should be rewarded, which the best way to emphasize their improvements and efforts.
review.overall: Em đi đủ bốn ý theo dàn ý và có nhiều cụm đúng của buổi học. Em cần sửa những câu thiếu động từ hoặc dùng sai dạng từ để chuỗi lập luận không bị đứt.

paragraphs: Opinions are divided over whether schools should reward students with the best academic results or whether it is more important to reward students who show progress. I believe that both groups should be recognized and rewarded.

Admittedly, rewarding students with outstanding academic results is reasonable. Since those students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage them and other students to study harder, thereby contributing to overall academic gains. Furthermore, competition exists in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Becoming familiar with this reality can help students thrive in the face of fierce competition and may prepare them better for success in later life.

However, students who show progress should also be rewarded. If only a few high-achieving students receive rewards, other students may think that their effort is futile because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, students may feel overwhelmed and disheartened and may gradually lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, recognizing improvement can encourage all students to work diligently and to understand that they need to keep improving themselves, irrespective of their current performance. The constant desire to outdo themselves can even benefit them more than competing against others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that both students with outstanding results and those who make progress should be rewarded. This is the best way to recognize achievement and effort.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
